stock.description: Evergreen Products Group Limited operates as an investment holding entity primarily involved in the design, production, distribution, and international sale of hair products. The company boasts a significant global presence, serving markets in the United States, the People's Republic of China, the United Kingdom, Japan, and Germany, among other regions. Its comprehensive product range encompasses various fashion wigs, including long, medium, short, and half styles, alongside an assortment of lace wigs like lace front, parting, braided, and 4x4 configurations. Additionally, Evergreen offers hairpieces and accessories such as Melrose clips, drawstrings, domes, buns, and headbands. The portfolio also extends to hair extensions, weaving products, men's wigs and toupees, seasonal Halloween wigs, costumes, moustaches, beards, and doll wigs. Beyond its core hair product ventures, the company actively participates in technological development within the hair product industry, engages in property investment and holding, conducts online hair product trading, manages a carton business, and handles the import and export of hair products. Established in 1962, Evergreen Products Group Limited is headquartered in Kwai Chung, Hong Kong, and operates as a subsidiary of Evergreen Enterprise Holdings Limited.
